name: Eno
description: Claude plugin for vibe-coding guidance and Vercel-first website go-live automation with custom domain setup.
author: Eno Team

capabilities.title: Vibe Coding Advisor
capabilities.description: Provides practical prompts, readiness checklists, and common mistakes with fixes.

capabilities.title: Analyze Project
capabilities.description: Detect static vs Next.js and report deploy blockers.

capabilities.title: Prepare Deploy Vercel
capabilities.description: Generate Vercel-first deployment checklist, commands, and basic GitHub readiness checks.

capabilities.title: Connect Domain
capabilities.description: Generate DNS records and provider templates for Cloudflare, GoDaddy, Namecheap, and generic DNS.

capabilities.title: Validate Go Live
capabilities.description: Validate apex/www DNS mapping and HTTPS go-live checklist.
